title: Violation
description: The unit of output from an analyzer. Deliberately language-agnostic.

Violation.title: Violation
Violation.description: A single rule violation found in a source file.

file.description: Absolute path. Analyzers must not report repo-relative paths.

endLine.description: Optional 1-based ending line of the violation range.

endColumn.description: Optional 1-based ending column of the violation range.

ruleId.description: Identifier of the rule that was violated.

snippet.description: The offending source text, whitespace-collapsed and truncated to 200 characters (with a trailing ellipsis when cut). The limit is stated numerically here on purpose: an analyzer written outside this repository cannot read a constant that lives only in the core's source.

guidance.description: Remediation guidance attached by the core from the rule's manifest.

SkippedFile.title: SkippedFile
SkippedFile.description: A file an analyzer could not process.

file.description: Absolute path of the file that could not be processed.

reason.description: Explanation of why the file was skipped.

Diagnostic.title: Diagnostic
Diagnostic.description: A runtime diagnostic emitted by an analyzer.

Severity.title: Severity
Severity.description: Default severity of a violation or rule.
